effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon. Then, if it's your turn, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card with [Imperialdramon] in its name or the [Free] trait in the hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
